body:
Full-codebase review, cross-client finding. Verified.

Deleting an item is guarded on Android and not on the web. Android shows a confirmation dialog from the item dialog (`item_delete_title`/`item_delete_body`) and deletes from the registry with an undo snackbar. The web deletes on the first press from both the list and the registry, with no confirmation and no undo — although the web does offer undo for checking an item off, so the pattern exists there.

Consequence: a mis-tap destroys a shared item for everyone on the web and is recoverable on Android.

Fix direction: give the web the same confirmation (and undo where Android has it), with the strings paired across the clients.
title: Cross-client: deleting an item is confirmed and undoable on Android, immediate on web
